artifact_reproduction.on: 2026-11-12 base rows (pre-fix replay), artifact train window

diagnostics_after_verdict.note: informational; computed after the pinned verdict

rule.LEAVE_AS_IS_if: no significant improvement and point deltas within noise (|ml_brier| < 0.0005 and |margin_log_score| < 0.002) or favouring the artifact

REFIT_requires_all.market_not_worse: holdout-window corr(served - line, actual - line) of refit >= artifact - 0.02
REFIT_requires_all.robust_without_trigger_window: holdout before 2026-10-01: margin_log_score delta >= 0 and ml_brier delta <= 0.0002
REFIT_requires_all.significant_improvement: margin_log_score CI low > 0, or ml_brier CI high < 0, or ml_log_loss CI high < 0

rule.estimator: cfb_v5_research.fit_params(k=6, conference_scale=True) on train: the artifact's own estimator
rule.holdout_scoring: served negative-binomial engine, 200k sims, common random numbers per event; paired deltas refit minus artifact with a date-clustered bootstrap (2000 resamples, seed 11)
rule.selection: among refit candidates, lowest validation moneyline Brier (Gaussian stand-in), then margin log score

new_raw_on_old_raw_2026_11_12_base_rows.note: current replay's raw margin regressed on the 2026-11-12 replay's raw margin, same event ids

script.note: git_blob_sha is the analyze-time version; decompose/extras/interpretation were added afterwards (informational sections only)
